checks.result: 0 errors in B12 files; remaining errors are in cursor-transcripts, cursor-usage-export, manual/marker, opencode (other owners)

supported_fields: ai.session: sessionId, cliVersion, originator, source, modelProvider, branchAtStart, commitAtStart, turnCount, toolCalls, usageRecords
ai.turn: turnId, turnKey, model, effort, startedAt, completedAt, durationMs (agent run time, not human waiting), status completed|aborted|open, toolCalls, toolNames
ai.usage: requestId=response_id, requestKey source:codex-session:request:<response_id>, tokens input/cachedInput/cacheWrite/output/reasoning/total (source-reported, raw names kept), model
payload.allocation {state provisional|unassigned, reason} on every event; payload.cost = unavailable
gaps: Cost/charge always unavailable: rollouts carry no price or billing; no list-price estimate is made.
Branch allocation is at most provisional (cwd inside flight worktree and start branch not contradicting); never strong. Codex records no branch per turn.
input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens and output_tokens includes reasoning (fieldSemantics notes this); consumers must not add subsets.
Legacy rollouts without token_usage_record fall back to token_count last_token_usage deltas with no request ID (requestKey null, unassigned for overlap); only fixture-verified on this host.
Imports one explicitly selected .jsonl (--input); no directory discovery of ~/.codex/sessions.
Not registered: integration registry/barrel belongs to A02/A07/A08; collector needs FileSystem (NodeServices.layer).
Cursor ignores CollectCursor input; re-import is idempotent via deterministic event IDs (active sessions can be re-imported as they grow).
